stories.title: One person dead after stabbing on TTC bus, Toronto police say
stories.summary: Toronto police said officers were called to Eglinton and Falmouth avenues at 10:04 p.m. for reports of someone stabbed on a TTC bus.

stories.title: Sentencing hearing to continue for Kenneth Law, who admitted to aiding suicide
stories.summary: A sentencing hearing is set to continue Friday for an Ontario man who sold potentially deadly substances online to people who then used those products to take their own lives.

stories.title: Doug Ford advises Ontarians to protect against home invasions by any means
stories.summary: Doug Ford said Thursday he wants to see legal changes to address a spate of home invasions, and in the meantime he advised people to protect their families by any means necessary.

stories.title: Rare three-day break lets Raptors reflect, reset
stories.summary: A rare three-day break, coinciding with American Thanksgiving, gave Scottie Barnes and his Toronto Raptors teammates a chance to pause and maybe reset after a disappointing start to the season.

stories.title: Parts of Ontario under freezing rain special advisory
stories.summary: Environment Canada issued several freezing rain advisories across Ontario early Thursday morning. It says a low pressure system will move into the region around midnight.

stories.title: Motorcycle and scooter-style e-bikes on Ontario roads to soon face stiffer rules
stories.summary: Drivers of motorcycle-style and motor scooter e-bikes in Ontario will soon have to get a licence, registration and insurance to operate the vehicles on roads in the province.

stories.title: Two arrested in home invasions targeting luxury vehicles across Peel, Toronto
stories.summary: Two people have been arrested in an investigation into five home invasions targeting luxury vehicles across Brampton, Mississauga and Toronto.

stories.title: Ford, Unifor call for Canadian automakers to be exempt from GHG penalties
stories.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford and Unifor National President Lana Payne said greenhouse gas emissions regulations pose “significant costs” for the Canadian auto sector.

stories.title: Blue Rodeo honours ‘great Toronto musician’ killed in midtown home invasion
stories.summary: A Toronto musician killed in a home invasion was an “absolute wizard” the pedal steel guitar, iconic Canadian band Blue Rodeo says.

stories.title: Ontario was warned about career college with skyrocketing OSAP growth, letter shows
stories.summary: Career Colleges Ontario flagged in a January 2025 letter to the ministry it was concerned about unusually high growth in Ontario Student Assistance Program usage at 10 campuses.
